vision: A distributable library of AI coding assistant rules, skills, hooks, and an adversarial verification harness for Cursor and Claude Code. The library must dogfood its own authoring standards: every rule, skill, and validation gate should pass before the library is considered trustworthy.
direction: library/cursor/ is the single source of truth for distributable config. .cursor/ is local-only (gitignored, created via make setup). Validation (make validate) must pass with zero errors. Eval pipeline (Tier 1 static + Tier 3 session 27 scenarios) at 93% (368/394 checks). Zero scenarios below 70%. Phase 2 complete: hooks confirmed working in SDK bridge, contract-gate.sh path extraction fixed, deterministic enforcement chain operational (preToolUse DENIES writes → stop hooks verify contract). gap-13 resolved (4 scenarios jumped from 44-64% to 94-95%). Next: remaining gaps (gap-2, gap-4, gap-14 further improvement) and new features.
